title: Brik Pipeline Report Fragment v1
description: Per-stage report fragment emitted by stage.run after each stage completes. In multi-container CI (GitLab, Jenkins) each stage writes its fragment to brik-artifacts/<stage>.json; the notify stage aggregates all fragments via report.aggregate_fragments. Fragments are forward-compatible: the schema_version field is locked to '1.0' for v1 and consumers warn-and-skip on mismatch.

schema_version.description: Fragment schema version. Locked to '1.0' for v1.

stage.description: Stage name (lower-case, kebab-case for multi-word names).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset, recorded when the fragment is written (after the stage logic returns).

duration_ms.description: Stage wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Optional. Mirrors the value already recorded by summary.build.

rc.description: Stage exit code. 0 = success or skipped, non-zero = failure.

status.description: Stage status. 'skipped' covers config-skip cases (e.g. quality.lint.enabled=false) where rc=0 but the stage did not execute its full logic.

platform.description: CI platform on which this stage ran.

image.description: Docker image reference of the runner container, when applicable.

job_url.description: Direct URL to the CI job log, when the platform exposes one.

tech.description: Technical traceability payload. Open object: per-stage sub-chantiers (Phase 3) populate stack-specific fields without bumping schema_version.

business.description: Business outcome payload. Open object: per-stage sub-chantiers (Phase 3) populate domain-specific fields without bumping schema_version.
